findings.title: Massive duplication of SLA status detail selection
findings.failure: The PR duplicates the exact same 42-line `ServiceLevelAgreementStatusDetail` selection block 12 times (4 targets × 3 operation files). This creates 500 lines of duplicated code that will drift if SLA status fields change.
findings.fix: Extract the selection into a GraphQL fragment `fragment SlaStatusDetail on ServiceLevelAgreementStatusDetail` (either in a shared `fragments.graphql` file or within each query file) and use `...SlaStatusDetail` for each of the 4 targets.
findings.evidence: Apollo MCP server and `validateMcpOperations.ts` both parse the entire `operations/` directory together, so a shared fragment is fully supported. Even if kept per-file, a fragment reduces 168 lines to 54 lines per file.

checked_fine: The default `null` values for `$slaStatuses` and `$slaTypes` correctly result in a no-op filter in `threadDbFilterUtils.ts`.
The `__typename` field is correctly included in the union type selections.
All fields of the `ServiceLevelAgreementStatusDetail` union types are correctly selected.
